quarterly_data.quarter: Giantec Semiconductor results briefing Q&A: H1 2026 collective (09-16-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Senior IR manager Sun Yuan (H1 2026 collective results briefing): Q2 2026 net profit excluding non-recurring items was RMB 6,655 ten-thousand, up 147.20% quarter on quarter, as DDR5 SPD chips and high-reliability automotive and industrial EEPROMs shipped much more than in Q1 with some end markets recovering and SOCAMM2 and LPCAMM2 modules entering commercial use; H1 PC and smartphone product sales fell as tight memory-die supply and sharp price rises pressured those markets. For H2 the company will adjust SPD capacity to market conditions and add final-test items, push automotive EEPROM in Europe, the US, Korea and Japan, and moderately adjust prices of some consumer products in light of upstream costs and demand.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 recurring net profit RMB 6,655 ten-thousand (+147.20% QoQ)
